question: I make food for plants and trees using sunlight. Who am I?
Plants need me to make their food. I shine during the day. Who am I?
Plants drink me through their roots. Who am I?
Plants take me from the air to make food. Who am I?
I hold a plant in the ground and help it get water. Who am I?
I carry water from the roots to the leaves. Who am I?
Plants release me into the air. People and animals need me to breathe. Who am I?
I am the center of our solar system. All planets go around me. Who am I?
I am the planet where you live. Who am I?
I pull things toward the ground. Who am I?
I am frozen water. Who am I?
I fall from clouds and help plants grow. Who am I?
You breathe me in, and plants breathe me out. Who am I?
I change from a caterpillar and I can fly. Who am I?
I am a star you can see during the day. Who am I?
